title: Black Lace Top & Blue Sky

Her expression is calm and serious, with a direct gaze. Warm, natural sunlight with a soft blurred background. Palette of black, sky blue, and warm skin tones. Candid and grunge-inspired, in the style of a film photo.
workingNotes:
